statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); user=$(whoami); dir_path="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"; IFS='/' read -ra SEGMENTS <<< "$dir_path"; if [ ${#SEGMENTS[@]} -gt 4 ]; then dir_display="…/${SEGMENTS[-3]}/${SEGMENTS[-2]}/${SEGMENTS[-1]}"; else dir_display="$dir_path"; fi; git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then status_info=""; if [ -n "$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then status_info="*"; fi; git_info=" $branch$status_info"; fi; fi; lang_info=""; if [ -f "$cwd/package.json" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node_version=$(node --version 2>/dev/null | sed 's/v//'); lang_info="${lang_info} node:$node_version"; fi; if [ -f "$cwd/Cargo.toml" ] && command -v rustc >/dev/null 2>&1; then rust_version=$(rustc --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); lang_info="${lang_info} rust:$rust_version"; fi; if ([ -f "$cwd/requirements.txt" ] || [ -f "$cwd/pyproject.toml" ] || [ -f "$cwd/setup.py" ]) && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python_version=$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); lang_info="${lang_info} py:$python_version"; fi; if [ -f "$cwd/go.mod" ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then go_version=$(go version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's/go//'); lang_info="${lang_info} go:$go_version"; fi; docker_info=""; if ([ -f "$cwd/Dockerfile" ] || [ -f "$cwd/docker-compose.yml" ] || [ -f "$cwd/docker-compose.yaml" ]) && command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker_context=$(docker context show 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$docker_context" ] && [ "$docker_context" != "default" ]; then docker_info=" docker:$docker_context"; fi; fi; current_time=$(date +%R); output=""; output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;127m %s \033[0m' "$user")"; output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;168m %s \033[0m' "$dir_display")"; if [ -n "$git_info" ]; then output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;216m%s \033[0m' "$git_info")"; fi; if [ -n "$lang_info" ]; then output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;110m%s \033[0m' "$lang_info")"; fi; if [ -n "$docker_info" ]; then output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;30m%s \033[0m' "$docker_info")"; fi; output="${output}$(printf '\033[48;5;24m %s \033[0m' "$current_time")"; output="${output} "; echo -n "$output"
